verdict.rationale: Recurring job or workflow scheduling is a fair question for an AI model-hosting and API platform like Replicate, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers running models, fine-tuning, deploying with Cog, autoscaling and billing, but nothing documents a cron-like or recurring scheduler. Autoscaling and one-off runs ('one line of code') are adjacent behaviors, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
